T0101.title: Manual Welfare Data Harvesting
T0101.definition: Manual collection of personal data from poverty-aid recipients or other vulnerable groups by criminals posing as aid, research, or service personnel.
T0101.description:
Manual welfare data harvesting targets vulnerable groups through social media, chat groups, offline visits, or fake public-service outreach. Operators pose as aid workers, researchers, or officials to induce low-income people, subsidy recipients, or poverty-aid targets to provide IDs, bank cards, addresses, subsidy records, and other sensitive data.

The collected data can be used for subsidy fraud, identity misuse, targeted scams, or resale. Controls focus on minimizing public exposure of beneficiary data, detecting impersonated aid outreach, anti-fraud education for vulnerable groups, data-flow auditing, and verification of offline collection channels.

T0101.usageExample: A gang dispatched members to infiltrate rural communities for Manual Poverty-Lead Harvesting under the guise of a "poverty alleviation survey," registering the ID numbers and bank card details of low-income residents door-to-door and compiling the data to sell to fraud rings.
